newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Tennis-Sanchez Vicario moves into second round.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Tennis-Sanchez Vicario moves into second round.

text.p: World number three Arantxa Sanchez Vicario moved into the second round of the Australian Open with a 6-4 6-4 win against Italian Gloria Pizzichini on Tuesday.
The Spanish baseliner, seeded two at Melbourne Park in the absence of American Monica Seles because of injury, will play Belgian Stephanie de Ville in the second round.
Sanchez Vicario has never lost before the quarter-final stage in Melbourne but has yet to lift the title.
The stocky right-hander is seeking to end a depressing run of defeats in the last five grand slam finals she has contested.
